review.reviewer: Gauss and Zeno read-only campaign reviewers
findings: Revision 1 REC-109-M03 had an invalid seed: HAVING requires a grouped baseline, so the MQ2001 at HAVING was a seed-construction failure rather than candidate behavior.
Revision 2 REC-109-M03-v2 uses a valid grouped baseline and mutates the alias boundary immediately before GROUP BY; the retained HAVING suffix is a distinct contextual fingerprint.
Revision 2 REC-109-D04 observed MQ2031_InvalidScriptParameterDeclaration. CORE-006 and REWORK-079 independently establish MQ2031 for C# declaration-order syntax, so revision 3 uses REC-109-D04-v2.

Revision 2 S01 and S05 retained MQ2001 but exposed false ASC guidance. The parser enhancer repair is scoped to the structured ASOF RIGHT and ASOF RIGHT OUTER phrase and preserves generic MQ2001 elsewhere.

sourceJustification.revision1Observation: The frozen seed 'select 1 from a.first() a cross apply a.Column item having 1 = 1' produced MQ2001 at HAVING before the mutation was reached.
sourceJustification.correction: Use REC-109-M03-v2 with grouped seed 'select 1 from a.first() a cross apply a.Column item group by 1 having 1 = 1' and mutate 'item group' to 'group'.
sourceJustification.reason: The v1 seed omitted GROUP BY, while HAVING is a suffix of GROUP BY in the bound grammar. The corrected candidate observes the missing APPLY alias at the first source boundary and retains HAVING as a downstream clause.

authority.passage: HAVING belongs to the grouped query clause sequence and cannot serve as a standalone baseline after a source.
HAVING is parsed after an existing GROUP BY clause.
An unaliased APPLY source reports MQ2035 at the next source boundary.

sourceJustification.revision2Observation: The frozen C#-style mutation 'param(string author)' produced MQ2031_InvalidScriptParameterDeclaration, not the broader MQ2032 expectation.
sourceJustification.reason: The parser distinguishes declaration-order/colon errors from unsupported foreign declaration syntax. Existing CORE-006 and REWORK-079 contracts classify param(string author) as MQ2031.

authority.passage: A parameter name not followed by a colon reports MQ2031_InvalidScriptParameterDeclaration.
param(string author) is an exact MQ2031 contract.
C# declaration-order syntax is covered by MQ2031.

productionFindings.observed: The unsupported ASOF RIGHT and ASOF RIGHT OUTER forms emitted MQ2001 with a false 'Replace asof with ASC' quick fix.
productionFindings.repair: Keep MQ2001, recognize only the exact ASOF RIGHT/ASOF RIGHT OUTER JOIN context, and provide ASOF-specific bounded guidance and suggestions.
